annotations.title: Opt into a campaign — get your tracked link

description: Signed in, roster creator: opt into a live campaign (`campaign_id` from amplify_campaigns) and receive the tracked link rokha.ai/?r=<handle>&c=<campaign>. Post as yourself and label it #ad. The post itself earns nothing and no deliverable is paid — only the outcomes your link brings score board points.
